name: Stirling-PDF
description_en: #1 PDF Application on GitHub that lets you edit PDFs on any device anywhere
readme_excerpt: Stirling PDF - The Open-Source PDF Platform Stirling PDF is a powerful, open-source PDF editing platform. Run it as a personal desktop app, in the browser, or deploy it on your own servers with a private API. Edit, sign, redact, convert, and automate PDFs without sending documents to external services. Key Capabilities - Everywhere you work - Desktop client, browser UI, and self-hosted server with a private API. - 50+ PDF tools - Edit, merge, split, sign, redact, convert, OCR, compress, and mor…
